title: On the Meta-Design of Allocation Problems
abstract: arXiv:2602.08786v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: There is an extensive literature that studies how to find optimal policies in resource allocation problems, taking the underlying design parameters that define the allocation, such as what data is collected, how many people can be served, and quality of service as fixed constraints. Yet, from a planner's perspective, these design parameters are themselves optimization variables that are just as important in determining overall welfare as selecting the optimal targeting rule for a given set of constraints. This realization motivates a rich set of meta-design questions exploring how planners should make principled decisions about investments in prediction, capacity constraints, and treatment quality, all of which lie upstream of classical policy optimization. translated_abstract: 关于如何在资源配置问题中寻找最优策略已有大量文献研究，这些研究通常将定义分配的底层设计参数——例如收集什么数据、可以服务多少人、服务质量如何——视为固定约束。然而，从规划者的视角来看，这些设计参数本身就是优化变量，它们对于决定总体福利的重要性，与在给定约束集下选择最优目标定位规则不相上下。这一认识引发了一系列丰富的元设计问题，探讨规划者应如何在预测能力、容量约束和治疗质量的投资上做出有原则的决策，而这些都位于经典策略优化的上游。在该领域的初步理论工作基础上，我们的论文有三个主要贡献。首先，我们正式定义了资源配置问题中广泛的元设计空间……
tldr: 该论文正式提出了资源配置问题的“元设计”框架，将传统上被视为固定约束的设计参数（如数据收集、服务容量、治疗质量）本身作为优化变量，研究规划者如何在经典策略优化的上游做出有原则的投资决策。
en_tdlr: This paper formally defines the "meta-design" space of resource allocation problems, treating design parameters—such as data collection, capacity constraints, and treatment quality—typically assumed fixed as optimization variables, and studies how planners should make principled investment decisions upstream of classical policy optimization.
